requestedIntent: Reduce Full BMAD execution time without removing independent semantic controls by eliminating model-driven bookkeeping, reusing only the story Developer session, and bounding reviewer context with raw hash-bound capsules.
limitations: The first candidate keeps every semantic actor on gpt-5.6-sol/high; lower-cost semantic routing is shadow-only until separately measured.

A review capsule is additive transport and cannot replace independent reviewer judgment or targeted reads needed to resolve a named uncertainty; a reviewer may rerun the focused command only for a named evidence conflict.
The runtime is enforced by schemas, writers, validators, tests, and installer wiring but has not yet passed the frozen end-to-end rehearsal, so it is not proven or installed in target repositories.
Existing Full runs with lifecycle evidence cannot adopt this runtime contract in place.

evidence.note: Covers deterministic next-action selection, model-free scope/capsule preparation, exact discovery, one Developer turn/follow-up policy, independent capsule generation, current-HEAD/report binding, and tamper failure.
Covers state-aware precommit and conditional deterministic story close compatibility.
Covers model-cycle accounting, aggregate cost, runtime profile enforcement, and capsule-supervisor budgets.
